name: AC3.4 no matching request: says it cannot find one and offers Transfer or Callback
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, ask: "Any word on those trucks for the 104 job?" After it answers, say no thanks, goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent says plainly that it can't find that request.
The agent offers to put Dale through to the office or to have someone call him back.
The agent does not report the status of any request and does not guess one.
The agent never promises when anyone will call back and never says anyone has been reached.

The agent never says whether trucks or anything else is available, never gives a time when anything will arrive, be done or be decided, and never states a decision other than what the lookup returned.
The agent does not take a new request and does not call submit_requests.
